messages:
nina-sales: Quick ask  Prospect AtlasCorp wants to kick off a 7-day POC but procurement says they need SOC 2 summary, ISO cert, and a signed pen-test attestation before staging creds. Can we turn these around today?

cal-se: We usually provide the SOC2 summary + redacted control mapping. I can pull that now. What redactions are required?

ana-security: Redact customer names and any specific user IDs. We can share the SOC2 Type II summary and the ISO cert PDF with no issue. For the pen-test, we provide a signed attestation (we don't share raw reports).

jon-ps: Procurement specifically wants a letter on company letterhead with a named signatory. Who can sign? CISO or Director?

ana-security: Director of Security can sign immediately. If they insist on CISO title, we need legal approval and it may delay. I'll sign as Director and include contact info.

artifacts-bot: action: presigned S3 upload link created (expires 7d)  DM'd to nina-sales (link hidden).

nina-sales: They also asked about EU residency for the POC (eu-west-1). Can we promise region for a short demo or do we need Dedicated? Pricing is a blocker.

cal-se: For short trials we can run in eu-west-1 on Hosted with network isolation; it adds a regional delta. I'll estimate the cost and send numbers by EOD. KMS separation requires Dedicated and ~72h to provision.

lisa-legal: FYI if they request the full SOC2 report we need an NDA + secure transfer process. We'll assist with the NDA template if needed.

nina-sales: Action list: 1) ana upload signed pen-test attestation to presigned link (TODAY), 2) cal upload SOC2 summary + ISO cert to link (TODAY), 3) cal send eu pricing delta + KMS lead time (EOD), 4) nina follow up with AtlasCorp procurement.

ana-security: Will upload signed attestation and include signer email.

cal-se: SOC2 summary + ISO cert queued for upload. Sending pricing delta by EOD.

nina-sales: Thanks team ":thumbsup:"
